description:
MLG (an abbreviation derived from the esports organization Major League Gaming [ 1 ] ) is a meme aesthetic that satirizes professional gaming montages and 2010s internet culture. Popularized between 2014 and 2017, the style is defined by aggressive sensory overload, high-tempo dubstep, and a dense layering of "dank memes."

While originally created as a mockery of the self-serious "frag movies" in the competitive Call of Duty and Halo scenes, it has since been retrospectively adopted by Gen Z as an internet aesthetic. Modern appreciation for MLG often stems from nostalgia for the "pre-algorithmic" era of YouTube, with many viewing its vibrant and chaotic visuals as representative of 2010s digital maximalism.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Satire, absurdity, sensory overload, nostalgia
